cim: Artificial Intelligence is helping scientists listen in on the secret life of bats
cim_eredeti: Artificial Intelligence is helping scientists listen in on the secret life of bats
szoveg_eredeti:
LONDON (CBS, KYMA) - Artificial intelligence is helping scientists listen in on the secret life of bats.

Researchers in the UK are using Ai to analyze nearly 100 million bat calls, a task that would have taken a human 40 to 50 years.

They put ultrasonic recorders in more than 300 forest areas to capture sounds of them flying past.Scientists say Ai is helping identify species and track changes in their populations.

We found some of the rarest mammals in the UK, bat species such as the Barbastelle bat, which is also known as the star beard, and it has beautiful golden fur. This species has been found in areas its not been recorded before," said Dr Agata Staniewicz, Bat Conservation Trust.

Here in the states, the U.S. Geological Survey developed an Ai tool that recognizes calls of 30 North American bat species, making it faster and easier to learn which creatures are living in certain areas.
